maya: Heads-up: onboarding llama2-xxl-quant from partner A. Their config.json trips the validator in model-registry CI. Can someone take a quick look?

oliver: I can. What error are we seeing?

maya: Validator output (from CI):
```
ERROR: config.json: field 'max_seq' expected integer but got string '2048'
ERROR: config.json: missing required 'tokenizer.name' field
ERROR: config.json: 'weights_url' scheme 'gcs' not allowed (allowed: s3, https)
```

maya: Also tokenizer had a weird special token id -1 for BOS which our runtime chokes on during tokenization. Not sure if it's intentional.

oliver: Quick notes:
- We should tighten schema types (no string for ints).
- Allow weight URL schemes: add 'gs'/'gcs' support in path validation or at least accept 'gs://' in model-registry and translate to internal downloaders.
- Add tokenizer constraints: bos_id and eos_id must be >= 0 or null. If -1 used to signal 'none' we should normalize to null during onboarding.

henry: Agree. For attention/backcompat, also validate 'attention_impl' and 'device_map' fields. We had a buggy model the other week because attention_impl was set to 'flash' but model arch isn't supported -> runtime fallback, silent perf hit. Let's add allowed enums: ["triton","flash","fallback"].

jun: I'll submit a small PR to model-registry with two things: schema tightening using jsonschema draft-07 and a new pre-merge hook that runs a lightweight runtime compatibility check (tokenizer sanity + weights URL ping). Link when ready.

oliver: Thanks. Two implementation details:
1) For schema defaults: add explicit defaults for batch_size, max_seq, pad_token_id, dtype (float16) so downstream consumers don't assume.
2) For error messages, include field path like 'tokenizer.bos_token_id' so partners can quickly fix.

qa: Note for CI: please don't make the schema so strict that partner-internal test models fail nightly. We need a migration/compatibility mode flag ("lenient_on_onboard": true) for older repos.

maya: Good call. Proposal: default onboarding mode = strict; add 'legacy_compat: true' option for partner uploads. We'll document in onboarding checklist.

henry: Also add a validator rule to verify that quantization config matches runtime capabilities: e.g., if 'quantize': "4bit" then require 'quant_backend' in ["llm-int8", "awq", "smoothquant"] else fail.

oliver: I'm taking the owner task to update schema + tests. Will:
- update JSON schema (types + enums + defaults),
- add normalization step for tokenizer ids (-1 -> null),
- accept gs:// in weights_url and map to downloader,
- add one integration test for llama2-xxl-quant sample.
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/412 (draft) :eyes:

jun: I'll add the pre-merge hook in CI and a tiny runtime binary that checks tokenization for a min set of inputs. Saves us from later surprises.

maya: Timeline? We need this for partner's dedicated launch next week. Can we get the schema change + CI hook by EOD Wednesday? :pray:

oliver: I'll aim for EOD Wednesday. If blocker, will flag earlier.

sre-bot: deploy-check: staging lint + tests queued for PR#412. ETA ~ 45m.

qa: I'll reserve some time Thursday for a quick onboarding smoke test with partner weights once PR merges.

maya: Awesome. Thanks everyone. Leaving a small checklist: update schema, normalize tokenizer ids, accept gs://, add enum checks, add CI hook, run smoke test. @oliver @jun @qa please tag when done. :thumbsup:

oliver: Roger. Starting now.

jun: I'll follow up with the CI patch shortly.

(End of thread)
